subject: [RFC PATCH v3 04/14] mm/memcontrol: Allocate per-tier page_counters

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds support for tier-aware limits in the Linux memory controller by allocating a page_counter array per memory tier for each mem_cgroup. The array is sized to the number of node IDs and allocated only when tiered limits are enabled, reducing memory usage when the feature is off. The patch also initializes and parent-links every slot in the array during mem_cgroup allocation and frees it during mem_cgroup deallocation.
